edits.old: Then the change is refused with Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S4-E5003-APP-AC12), nothing is written and no timer starts
edits.new:
Then the change is refused with Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S4-E5003-APP-AC12), nothing is written and no timer starts

  Scenario: AC10 Rules of section 8 without a legacy criterion (new in this story, from BR1, BR2, BR4, BR5, BR6, BR7 and BR8 of section 8)
    Given a case in state NOTICE_DISPATCHED with the notice "NT-2026-000301" delivered on "2026-03-16"
    When the notice period is started
    Then the period is a durable timer of the litigation stage, its length is read from the versioned reference row and its expiry is delivered_at plus that length, never the dispatch date
    Then the notice stays with rwb-comms and the timer ledger row stays with rwb-case
    Then the decision record is written before the case moves and a failed write changes nothing
    Then action_type and status take only the values of LOV-LEGAL-TYPE and LOV-LEGAL-STATUS in force, read with their version
    Then the service reads no v_ace_* view, no ACE table and no other rwb_* schema
    Then the row, the decision record, the timer state, the logs and every call carry no borrower or guarantor data
    Then a repeat of the same signal writes once and is counted

  Scenario: AC11 Error answers of the provided operations (new in this story, from the error answers of section 7 and exception X2)
    Given a call to API-S4-001, API-S4-002 or API-S4-003 without a valid credential
    Given a call from a role without the Litigation right
    Given the notice "NT-2026-000301" that belongs to another case than the action
    When each call is made
    Then the call without a valid credential answers 401 with the platform envelope
    Then the call from the role without the Litigation right answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 and nothing is written
    Then the notice read of the other case answers 404 and nothing is written and no timer starts

  Scenario: AC12 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key (new in this story, from BR8 of section 8)
    Given a case in state NOTICE_DISPATCHED with the notice "NT-2026-000301" delivered on "2026-03-16"
    Given the first write of the notice was made with an Idempotency-Key
    When the same write is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then the repeat is counted and writes nothing
    Then no second decision record, no second proof attach and no second timer is made
